nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: Push is preferred over the generated cypher.txt because FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time and has no bulk script import like Neo4j's cypher-shell.

nodes.label: Graphify MCP Stdio Server
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats and shortest_path so other agents can query the graph live; Claude Desktop must be given the absolute interpreter path because it cannot run command substitution.

nodes.label: Agent-Crawlable Wiki Export
nodes.rationale: Runs before cleanup so .graphify_labels.json is still on disk.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only runs above 5,000 words: for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression, so the benchmark is skipped silently rather than reported misleadingly.
